title: SvelteKit #15004: TypeError Cannot read private member #state from Response proxy

error_signal.message: sveltekit TypeError: Cannot read private member #state from an object whose class did not declare it at Proxy.clone in page load_data

ground_truth.root_cause_description: On Node v24+, undici's Response has private class fields. When SvelteKit proxies the Response in page load, clone() fails because the proxy cannot access private #state. Fix: use Reflect.apply and Object.defineProperties to properly delegate method calls.
ground_truth.fix_description: Apply MDN recommended fix for proxying objects with private fields
